pricing.title: Simple, Honest Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that's right for your family
pricing.heroTitle: Start Free, Upgrade When You're Ready
pricing.heroSubtitle: Create a beautiful memorial at no cost. Add more features if and when it feels right.
pricing.mostFamilies: Most families start with Free and find it's everything they need.
pricing.everythingToStart: Everything you need to get started
pricing.betterTogetherDesc: Memorials are most meaningful when family contributes together. Invite loved ones to share their photos and stories.
pricing.notSureYet: Not sure yet? That's okay. Start with Free and take all the time you need.
pricing.neverRushYou: You can always upgrade later, and we'll never rush you.
pricing.faqChangePlan: Can I change my plan later?
pricing.faqChangePlanAnswer: Yes! You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately with prorated billing.
pricing.faqNotReady: What if I'm not ready to decide?
pricing.faqNotReadyAnswer: Start with Free. It includes everything you need to create a meaningful memorial. There's no pressure to upgrade, ever. Take all the time you need.
pricing.faqCancelAnswer: Your memorials are never deleted. If you cancel a paid plan, you keep full access until your billing period ends, then continue on Free. Your memories stay safe.
pricing.faqPerpetualAnswer: It's our commitment to preserving your memorial permanently. We maintain redundant backups across multiple data centers with a 25-year storage guarantee, ensuring your memories are protected for generations.
pricing.faqRefundAnswer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. Contact us if you're not satisfied.
